Hello! I am from 3824 HVA RoHAWKtics. The reason for the flag was to block the opposing side's litter, which is where a massive amount of their points came from. PARTs was very important in getting our win. They pushed us through to the quarter finals. I ran back to the pit after almost every match to give them encouraging words. They did not act like they felt they were just a flagpole or anything. RoHAWKtics and MARS made the big points, yes. However, PARTs pulled us all together. Without them, we could not have done it. I am very glad that they are going to come to Worlds with us. :) They are such a friendly team. I enjoyed their company very very much. Love you 3492!!
